data.description:
## Context and confirmed RCA

Gerrit Verify run 31874837464 completed in 29m11s with macOS at 27m38s. The macOS default suite spent 20.88s in test_hook_falls_back_to_git_when_env_unset, 16.38s setting up the shared build-provenance artifact, 10.69s rebuilding from sdist, and 8.98s in one blank-env build. Ubuntu repeats the same package builds in all three Python cells. Local phase profiling showed the fallback exports and indexes the entire 3,019-file / 42.4MB checkout even though hatch_build.py only resolves one SHA and writes src/rebar/_build_info.py: git add costs 1.37-1.53s and python -m build costs 3.85-4.32s of a 6.04-6.38s local test. A paired same-hook prototype using a tiny package preserved the exact git-fallback wheel SHA and reduced two initial A/B pairs from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s.

Runtime experiment under the real -n 3 --dist worksteal selector confirmed that the session-scoped built_artifacts fixture initializes independently on all three workers: the three consumers each paid 6.60-6.74s setup and launched three full successful builds. This is a bounded latency and runner-occupancy contributor, not the explanation for multi-minute host variation.

A required correctness prerequisite was also proven from live run logs. The artifact-probe job received GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION=9aecb53e and checked out that patchset, but its build step used GITHUB_SHA=7d908fbb from the trusted-main workflow dispatch. Its assertions accept any non-null COMMIT, so the full-package probe passed artifacts stamped with the wrong source commit. The exact source identity is an existing contract from ducal-statuelike-ladybird.

## Ticket and OSS research

No prior rejection exists. ducal-statuelike-ladybird requires real sdist/wheel, git-fallback, blank-env, and exact provenance behavior; this plan retains them. square-tragic-llama explicitly accepted a self-contained minimal Git fixture while requiring the exact fallback SHA and shallow-source negative control. despotic-dorsal-greatdane approved immutable artifact reuse but intentionally stopped at per-worker session scope. cryptic-damp-panda identified repeated package builds as a coverage-neutral residual lever.

Four popular active projects use the proposed placement: pytest 68308aa has one dedicated Ubuntu package job before its broad matrix; pip f399c371 has dedicated packaging jobs separate from Unix/Python tests; Poetry 92b74dc has one Ubuntu build/install smoke job separate from its OS/Python matrix; Pydantic 02c5c975 has a dedicated Ubuntu distribution build separate from its broad matrix. This is 4/4 OSS consensus for one full-package integration job plus lighter behavioral testing in the broad matrix. Rebar remains stricter by retaining real isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel behavior in every existing cell with the unchanged production hook.

## Plan

1. Freeze RED workflow and behavior contracts before implementation. The workflow oracle must reject GITHUB_SHA as artifact provenance, require git rev-parse --short HEAD after the final Gerrit checkout, and require exact equality in both installed wheel and sdist probes. The build-hook oracle must keep exact env SHA, preserved sdist SHA, git fallback SHA, and blank-env failure through real isolated python -m build.
2. Extract a reusable test fixture that creates a tiny temporary Hatch package around the checkout current hatch_build.py and src/rebar/_build_info.py boundary. Initialize and commit that tiny tree so the real git fallback executes. Do not copy, archive, index, or package the full Rebar checkout for hook-semantics probes.
3. Convert the repeated build-hook semantic tests in test_attestation_signing.py and test_build_provenance.py to the minimal actual-hook package. Retain every named assertion, the no-git branch, the direct real-Rebar WheelBuilder package-content test, and the shallow-source negative control. Keep default PEP 517 isolation; do not mock Hatchling, Git, archive creation, or wheel inspection.
4. Keep the existing full-Rebar sdist/wheel/install replay in the Verify artifact-probe job. After the final checkout, derive the expected short SHA from git rev-parse HEAD, build with that value, and assert the installed wheel and install-from-sdist both equal it exactly. Preserve all import, CLI, schema, packaging, and vote-gating probes.
5. Prove test teeth by seeding the exact wrong-SHA defect and one precedence defect; each corresponding oracle must return RED before restoration. Compare current and repaired focused tests serially and under the exact xdist selector. Timing is evidence only.
6. Run focused tests, workflow consumers, actionlint/zizmor through make lint, typecheck, and the full default/integration selectors. Push one necessary implementation change through Gerrit immediately; do not create a control-only run. Record macOS/Ubuntu hosted durations and runner occupancy from that organic treatment.

## Test contract card

authoritative_contract: ducal-statuelike-ladybird requires real sdist-to-wheel provenance, exact env/git fallback behavior, blank-env failure, sdist preservation, and exact source identity; the current Verify workflow requires the artifact probe to run on the Gerrit patchset.
trigger_preconditions: every existing matrix cell executes the real hook through an isolated PEP 517 build; artifact-probe has completed the final Gerrit checkout.
production_path: hatch_build.py resolves and writes COMMIT during sdist and wheel builds; artifact-probe builds and installs the full checked-out Rebar distributions.
test_tier: minimal real-build behavioral probes across every current OS/Python cell plus one full-project artifact integration job on the exact patchset.
observable_postcondition: every existing provenance/failure assertion remains; full artifacts contain exactly git rev-parse --short HEAD of the final checkout.
negative_control: wrong nonempty SHA fails; blank env fails; no-git/no-bake remains None; shallow source remains supported.
collateral_invariants: no test selector, assertion, PEP 517 isolation, xdist worker, Python/platform cell, coverage, mutation, import/CLI/schema probe, runner, or vote dependency is removed.
ci_gate: focused serial/xdist tests, workflow contracts, make lint, make typecheck, full Gerrit Verified, LLM-Review.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every existing OS/Python cell still executes real isolated sdist-to-wheel builds with the production hatch_build.py for env, preserve-existing, git-fallback, and blank-env behaviors.
- [ ] Hook-semantics fixtures contain only the minimal package boundary and do not archive, index, commit, or package the full Rebar tree.
- [ ] The full-project artifact job derives the expected commit after final checkout and asserts exact equality for both wheel and install-from-sdist; a wrong nonempty SHA fails.
- [ ] The direct full-Rebar package-content test, shallow-source negative control, import/CLI/schema probes, all assertions, platforms, selectors, coverage, mutation, and vote dependencies remain enabled.
- [ ] A precedence defect mutation and wrong-SHA workflow mutation return the held-out oracles to RED, then restoration returns GREEN.
- [ ] Focused serial and exact-xdist timings show lower runner work without a timing gate; the first hosted treatment records macOS and all Ubuntu job/test durations.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, full relevant pytest, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and Gerrit merge are recorded before close.
data.title: Scale build-provenance fixtures and pin artifact probe to patchset SHA
